rows.note: Use this specifically for cosmetic foundation applied to the face.

example.english: I put on base makeup today, and my face looks more even.
example.traditional: 我今日搽咗粉底，塊面睇落均勻啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 caa4 zo2 fan2 dai2 faai3 min6 tai2 lok6 gwan1 wan4 di1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an abstract foundation, basis, or essential underlying component.

example.english: The most important thing in language learning is to build a solid base.
example.traditional: 學語言最重要係打好基礎。
example.jyutping: hok6 jyu5 jin4 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 hai6 daa2 hou2 gei1 co2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken pattern when an organization, facility, or operation is located at A.

example.english: The company’s base is in Kwun Tong, so it’s convenient for customers to visit.
example.traditional: 公司設喺觀塘，方便客人嚟。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 cit3 hai2 gun1 tong4 fong1 bin6 haak3 jan4 lei4

rows.note: Use this when a person, group, or organization operates from A as its base rather than merely being located there.

example.english: The volunteer team uses Hong Kong as its base and has helped in several countries.
example.traditional: 呢隊義工以香港為基地，去過幾個國家幫手。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi6 ji6 gung1 ji5 hoeng1 gong2 wai4 gei1 dei6 heoi3 gwo3 gei2 go3 gwok3 gaa1 bong1 sau2

rows.note: Use this specifically for troops or other units stationed at A.

example.english: We base our troops in Sai Kung.
example.traditional: 我哋將部隊駐紮喺西貢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 bou6 deoi6 zyu3 zaat3 hai2 sai1 gung3

rows.note: Use this when an idea, study, or treatment takes A as its foundation or starting point.

example.english: We base the new treatment on this study.
example.traditional: 我哋以呢個研究為基礎，設計咗個新療程。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ni1 go3 jin4 gau3 wai4 gei1 co2 cit3 gai3 zo2 go3 san1 liu4 cing4

rows.note: Use this when the base is an organization’s headquarters where decisions are made.

example.english: Our company's base moved to Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 我哋公司總部搬咗去香港。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 zung2 bou6 bun1 zo2 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2

rows.note: Use this specifically for one of the four bases in baseball.

example.english: The runner safely stepped on the base.
example.traditional: 個跑壘員安全咁踩到壘包喇。
example.jyutping: go3 paau2 leoi5 jyun4 on1 cyun4 gam3 caai2 dou3 leoi5 baau1 laa3
